flows.name: Save an item
preconditions: A fresh isolated catalog fixture contains item C-12 and an empty saved-item list
Synthetic editor is authorized to save; this is the allowed-role control for the denied fixture

steps.action: Open item C-12 from the visible result link
steps.expected: The detail dialog names C-12 and exposes the supported Save action
steps.evidence_plan: Capture the real link activation and fresh detail state

steps.expected: The result identifies C-12 as saved
steps.evidence_plan: Capture real activation and current result

steps.action: Read the isolated server-owned saved-item endpoint without mutation
steps.expected: C-12 occurs exactly once in the saved list
steps.evidence_plan: Retain the actual response with its fixture role and build identity

steps.action: Reload the page through the browser
steps.evidence_plan: Capture reload and current persisted state

steps.action: Open Saved in a second authorized isolated browser context
steps.expected: The same stored C-12 is present once
steps.evidence_plan: Capture second-consumer view against the same isolated server data

flows.name: Reject a viewer write
flows.goal: Understand denial without changing stored data
preconditions: Reset a separate isolated catalog fixture to the same empty saved-list baseline, with C-12 present in the catalog but absent from Saved
Preserve the exact empty baseline response before the attempt
The corresponding editor control succeeded; this context authenticates only the denied synthetic viewer

steps.action: Attempt the supported Save action as synthetic viewer
steps.expected: The server denies the action and the interface explains the permission problem
steps.evidence_plan: Capture the actual viewer action, response and visible denial

steps.action: Read the isolated source-owned saved-item list without mutation
steps.expected: The list is byte-for-byte equal to its frozen pre-attempt value
steps.evidence_plan: Retain baseline and current readbacks from the same isolated store
